subtitle.en: The complete ~2000 line source listing for The Witness's Lister Panel, header file and implementation included.
subtitle.zh: 《The Witness》Lister Panel 的完整源码清单，约 2000 行，头文件与实现文件俱全。

translator.note: 归档把这份约 2000 行的 C++ 清单按「看起来像正文的行」（else、enum、case、++i 之类）切成了 76 个代码围栏，大量代码行散落在围栏之外，围栏外还被插入了空行。译文按原帖的结构把这些行并回两份完整代码块（lister_panel.h 与 lister_panel.cpp），代码逐字保留英文原文、注释不翻译；代码里的 [REDACTED] 是归档对原文的删节标记，原样保留。

blocks.en: I should be back on a normal schedule next week, so Witness Wednesday Proper will resume next Wednesday.  I'd like to do a Q&A about the Lister Panel, if people are up for it, just so that beginners can take a look at the actual code as it is used in the editor and ask questions about why things are the way they are.  Sometimes the answer will be, "because I was in a hurry" :)  But hopefully I can answer most questions in a way that gives additional insight on why it was a good idea to do things roughly the way they were done in the code.
blocks.zh: 我下周应该就能回到正常的节奏，所以正牌的 Witness Wednesday（每周三连载）会在下周三恢复。如果大家有兴趣，我想就 Lister Panel 做一次问答，好让初学者能看一看编辑器里实际在用的代码，并就「为什么事情是这样的」提问。有时候答案会是「因为我当时赶时间」 :) 但希望大部分问题我都能答得让各位对「为什么按代码里这种大致做法来做事是个好主意」多一层理解。

blocks.en: Here is the complete ~2000 line source file that implements everything in the Lister Panel, along with its header file.  Both have been lightly redacted to remove any filters that might give away aspects of [The Witness](http://the-witness.net/news/)'s gameplay for people who want to remain spoiler-free, so there should be absolutely no spoiler risk in reading the code.
blocks.zh: 下面就是完整的、约 2000 行的源文件，它实现了 Lister Panel 里的全部功能，另外还有它的头文件。两份文件都做了轻度删节，去掉了那些可能泄露《The Witness》玩法内容的过滤器，好让想保持无剧透的人放心，所以读这份代码绝对没有剧透风险。

blocks.en: Keep in mind that this code is a mixture of styles ([Jon](http://number-none.com/blow/)'s and mine), because even though I wrote all the code, I adopted Jon's conventions in many places, just to make it easier for him to maintain.  This is also editor-only code, which means it is not meant to be used in a released product, and thus the emphasis is entirely on keeping implementation costs low, and not on ancillary things like robustness that might be more of a priority in code meant for end users.
blocks.zh: 请记住，这份代码混合了两种风格（[Jon](http://number-none.com/blow/) 的和我的）：虽然代码全是我写的，但很多地方我采用了 Jon 的约定，只是为了让他维护起来更容易。另外这还是仅限编辑器使用的代码，也就是说它并不打算用在正式发布的产品里，因此重点完全放在压低实现成本上，而不在健壮性这类附属问题上——如果代码是给最终用户用的，那些反倒可能才是优先事项。

blocks.en: So, if you are in the mood, please spend some time looking over the files and send questions.  I will collect them all and answer them next week!
blocks.zh: 所以，如果你有兴趣，请花点时间翻一翻这些文件，然后把问题发过来。我会把它们全部收集起来，下周统一回答！
